verdict.rationale: The pack only says that Salesforce APIs exist ('Discover Salesforce APIs & put them to work') and lists a CLI read command (`sf data query`). Neither documents bidirectional record sync, upserts, change detection, rate limits or behavior at scale. A generic API mention and a CLI query primitive are building blocks, not evidence of the sync capability the story describes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync records bidirectionally through the API at scale, with documented rate limits, upserts, and change detection
